description:
Workspace buttons, app icons and dock-style hover magnification in the GNOME top panel.

Move windows and reorder workspaces with drag-and-drop. Configure clicks, scrolling and touchpad swipes separately for app icons and workspace numbers. Tune magnification curves, spacing, focused-app highlights and appearance in native preferences.

Maintained by drkhn1234. Based on Workspace Bar by jguece.
name: Workspace Bar: Reloaded
author: drkhn1234
